title: For instances in availability zone “flare3” that also appear in migrations
question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” that also appear in migrations with status “completed”, show the migration ID, instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, the average memory_mb over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb), plus the instance system metadata key and value with a row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.

  m.id AS migration_id,
  i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
  i.display_name,
  i.vm_state,
  i.memory_mb,
  c.network_info AS cached_network_info,
  AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (
    PARTITION BY i.vm_state
    ORDER BY i.memory_mb
    ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
  ) AS avg_memory_mb_window,
  sm.`key` AS system_metadata_key,
  sm.`value` AS system_metadata_value,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY i.uuid
    ORDER BY sm.`key`
    ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
  ) AS metadata_row_number
FROM instances i
INNER JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid
LEFT JOIN instance_system_metadata sm ON i.uuid = sm.instance_uuid
WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
  AND m.status = 'completed'

SELECT
  m.id AS migration_id,
  i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
  i.display_name,
  i.vm_state,
  i.memory_mb,
  c.network_info AS cached_network_info,
  AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (
    PARTITION BY i.vm_state
    ORDER BY i.memory_mb
    ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
  ) AS avg_memory_mb_window,
  sm.`key` AS system_metadata_key,
  sm.`value` AS system_metadata_value,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY i.uuid
    ORDER BY sm.`key`
    ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
  ) AS metadata_row_number
FROM instances i
INNER JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid
LEFT JOIN instance_system_metadata sm ON i.uuid = sm.instance_uuid
WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
  AND m.status = 'completed'

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS migration_id,
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    i.display_name,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    c.network_info,
    AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.vm_state
      ORDER BY i.memory_mb
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS avg_memory_mb
  FROM instances i
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND m.status = 'completed'
),
meta AS (
  SELECT
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    s.`key` AS meta_key,
    s.`value` AS meta_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.uuid
      ORDER BY s.`key`
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
    ) AS meta_row_number
  FROM instances i
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  JOIN instance_system_metadata s ON s.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND m.status = 'completed'
)
SELECT
  b.migration_id,
  b.instance_uuid,
  b.display_name,
  b.vm_state,
  b.memory_mb,
  b.network_info,
  b.avg_memory_mb,
  mt.meta_key,
  mt.meta_value,
  mt.meta_row_number
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN meta mt ON mt.instance_uuid = b.instance_uuid
ORDER BY b.migration_id, b.instance_uuid, mt.meta_key;
